description: This file defines the WatchMessagingService class responsible for managing communication between an iOS app and a paired Apple Watch via WatchConnectivity framework. It includes methods for sending notifications, checking support and status, handling replies, and managing the session delegate. It also defines error types and status structures related to watch messaging.

classes.name: WatchMessagingService
classes.description: A service class managing communication with Apple Watch devices, including sending notifications, handling replies, and maintaining session state via the WatchConnectivity framework.

methods.name: isSupportedOnDevice
methods.description: Checks if WatchConnectivity is supported on the current device.

methods.name: currentStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Provides a snapshot of the current watch connectivity status.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current watch connectivity status.

methods.name: setReplyHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler to process quick reply events received from the watch.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification message to the watch with specified parameters, handling reachability and queuing if necessary.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the WCSession is activated before performing session-dependent actions.
